title: Persist last-viewed location/date via localStorage
description: index.html has no localStorage/sessionStorage usage at all — every reload resets to the hardcoded default location and 'today'. Store the last-selected lat/lon (and optionally date) in localStorage on change, and read it on load as the initial view (before falling back to the hardcoded default). Should compose with the URL query-param feature (bf-6w4) - explicit query params should win over localStorage, which wins over the hardcoded default. Small delight improvement for returning users. File: index.html.

title: Fix stale version strings + deployment docs in README/docker-compose

comments.author: cli
comments.text:
Documentation/metadata in shipped artifacts has drifted from reality (plan.md says the app ships at 0.1.3, deployed to ardenone-cluster utilities ns via declarative-config, behind Traefik + Cloudflare Tunnel).

Concrete drift (evidence):
- README.md line ~265 footer: 'Version: 0.1.0' while VERSION file = 0.1.3 and the deployment is pinned to :0.1.3. The auto-versioning only bumps the VERSION file, so this hardcoded footer perpetually drifts.
- docker-compose.yml line 14 label 'com.sun-simulator.version=1.0.0' — wrong version (also mismatches the 0.1.x line; initial commit was tagged v2.0.0).
- README.md Deployment section documents Cloudflare Pages / Vercel / Netlify / GitHub Pages as the deploy story; the actual production deploy per plan.md is k8s + ArgoCD (declarative-config k8s/ardenone-cluster/utilities/sun-sim-deployment.yml). Either mark these as generic static-host alternatives or replace with the real deploy note.
- README.md Quick Start (lines ~41-46) pulls sun-sim:latest and :0.1; :latest contradicts the workspace no-:latest convention and :0.1 is not a published tag. Use a real pinned tag (e.g. 0.1.3).
- Performance Metrics table (README ~245-255: pos +/-0.0067 deg, +/-39s, <2.1s load, 87KB gzipped, 58-60 FPS) is unsubstantiated, and plan.md ADR-001 explicitly notes the <2.1s load claim is not achievable while critical JS loads from two third-party CDNs. Correct/qualify once bf-4ld lands, or remove the specific numbers.

NOT covered by existing beads (bf-4ld/bf-8pd = vendoring/SRI; bf-32z..bf-4ke = Argo CI migration + GH Actions removal). This is purely artifact doc accuracy.

Acceptance criteria:
1. README footer + any version badge reflect current VERSION (0.1.3) OR are made version-agnostic so they cannot drift again.
2. docker-compose.yml version label removed or corrected to match VERSION.
3. README Deployment section states the real k8s/ArgoCD deploy or clearly frames Cloudflare/Vercel/Netlify/GH Pages as generic alternatives.
4. README docker pull examples use a valid pinned tag (no bare :0.1).
5. Performance-metrics numbers corrected/qualified or removed so no artifact claims something the shipped app does not currently do.

title: Verify sun-sim Argo CI green end-to-end (manual run + sunsim.jedarden.com deploy confirmation)
description:
Verification gate before GitHub Actions removal.

Steps:
1. Submit manual run: kubectl --kubeconfig=/home/coding/.kube/iad-ci.kubeconfig create -f - with kind Workflow, generateName sun-sim-build-manual-, ns argo-workflows, workflowTemplateRef sun-sim-build, serviceAccountName argo-workflow
2. Watch to Succeeded (podGC OnPodCompletion — stream logs WHILE running if debugging; Argo UI https://argo-ci.ardenone.com keeps failure logs 2h)
3. Confirm VERSION auto-bumped (e.g. 0.1.3 -> 0.1.4) and new semver tag on ghcr.io/jedarden/sun-sim
4. Confirm declarative-config commit pinned k8s/ardenone-cluster/utilities/sun-sim-deployment.yml to new semver and no other utilities-namespace app was touched
5. Confirm ArgoCD app utilities-ns-ardenone-cluster Synced+Healthy (curl -sk https://argocd-ro-ardenone-manager-ts.ardenone.com:8444/api/v1/applications/utilities-ns-ardenone-cluster) and pod runs new image (kubectl --server=http://traefik-ardenone-cluster:8001 get pods -n utilities)
6. Confirm https://sunsim.jedarden.com serves (curl -sI; ADB phone Chrome fallback if blocked)

Acceptance: all checks pass; record workflow name + image tag in close note (close via br batch --json, not br close).

title: Add ARIA live region for sun position readout (accessibility)
description: index.html has zero aria-* attributes or role= usage anywhere (grep confirmed). The azimuth/altitude/sunrise/sunset/solar-noon/day-length numbers that update as the user drags the timeline or pans the map are currently invisible to screen reader users - there's no way for them to perceive the app's core output. Add an aria-live=polite region (or aria-live=assertive if updates should interrupt) wrapping the sun-data display panel, and appropriate aria-label attributes on the interactive compass/timeline controls. Verify with a screen reader (e.g. Orca) or at minimum the accessibility tree in Chrome devtools. File: index.html.

title: Author Argo WorkflowTemplate sun-sim-build in declarative-config
description:
Create k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/sun-sim-build-workflowtemplate.yml in jedarden/declarative-config (clone at ~/declarative-config; git pull --rebase before touching, push immediately after commit).

Model on palm-reading-build-workflowtemplate.yml. Steps: resolve-version -> docker-build (kaniko) -> update-declarative-config.

Specifics for sun-sim:
- WorkflowTemplate name: sun-sim-build, ns argo-workflows, serviceAccountName argo-workflow
- Params: git-repo=jedarden/sun-sim, branch=main
- VERSION file EXISTS at repo root (currently 0.1.3, matches deployed image). Use the palm-reading resolve-version logic as-is: if VERSION changed in the head commit use it verbatim, else auto-bump patch and commit. Git identity user.email github@jedarden.com / user.name jedarden; GH_TOKEN from secret github-webhook-secret key token. The old GH workflow also created vX.Y.Z git tags and [skip ci] bump commits — the Argo convention drops git tagging; VERSION file + image tags are the source of truth (note this in the declarative-config commit message)
- kaniko: Dockerfile at repo root, context git://github.com/REPO.git#refs/heads/BRANCH, destinations ghcr.io/jedarden/sun-sim:VERSION + :latest. Registry auth: mount secret ghcr-jedarden-registry (exists in argo-workflows ns) as /kaniko/.docker (key .dockerconfigjson -> config.json). Pin kaniko executor to a version tag (e.g. v1.23.2), not :latest. Old GH workflow built multi-arch (amd64+arm64); kaniko is single-arch — amd64-only is acceptable since the only consumer is the ardenone-cluster deployment (note this regression in the bead close note)
- update-declarative-config: sed image tag in k8s/ardenone-cluster/utilities/sun-sim-deployment.yml (ghcr.io/jedarden/sun-sim:0.1.3 -> new semver), commit+push same identity. CAUTION: the utilities namespace dir contains other apps — sed only the sun-sim image line

Acceptance criteria:
1. File committed+pushed to declarative-config main
2. kubectl --kubeconfig=/home/coding/.kube/iad-ci.kubeconfig get workflowtemplate sun-sim-build -n argo-workflows succeeds

title: Wire Argo Events webhook trigger for sun-sim (eventsource entry + sensor)
description:
Wire push-to-main triggering for sun-sim-build, following the palm-reading pattern in jedarden/declarative-config k8s/iad-ci/argo-events/.

1. Add a sun-sim entry to github-eventsource.yml (EventSource github-webhooks, ns argo-events): owner jedarden, names [sun-sim], webhook endpoint /sun-sim, port 12000, url https://webhooks-ci.ardenone.com, events [push], apiToken+webhookSecret from github-webhook-secret (keys token / webhook-secret), insecure false, active true, contentType json. Controller auto-creates the GitHub webhook via apiToken.
2. Create sun-sim-sensor.yml modeled on palm-reading-sensor.yml: Sensor sun-sim-sensor in argo-events ns; dependency eventSourceName github-webhooks / eventName sun-sim; filters: headers.X-Github-Event == push, body.ref == refs/heads/main, plus auto-bump cascade guard — CRITICAL here because resolve-version pushes a VERSION bump commit on every code push; without a filter on commit message prefix ci: auto-bump (or equivalent) every build triggers exactly one follow-up build. Verify the loop terminates (the follow-up sees VERSION-changed-in-commit and rebuilds the same version once; an explicit filter avoids even that). Trigger: argoWorkflow submit, generateName sun-sim-build-, workflowTemplateRef sun-sim-build, params git-repo=jedarden/sun-sim branch=main.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Both files committed+pushed; argo-events app on iad-ci syncs
2. kubectl --kubeconfig=/home/coding/.kube/iad-ci.kubeconfig get sensor sun-sim-sensor -n argo-events exists
3. GitHub webhook appears on jedarden/sun-sim (gh api repos/jedarden/sun-sim/hooks)
4. A push to main produces exactly one build (no runaway cascade)

title: Remove .github/workflows from sun-sim after Argo CI verified green
description:
ONLY after the verification bead is closed green. Delete .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml from jedarden/sun-sim (git rm; remove empty .github/workflows dir). GH Actions are policy-banned in this workspace. The old workflow did VERSION auto-increment + git tagging + multi-arch ghcr push; the Argo sun-sim-build template replaces the version bump and image push (git tags dropped by convention, amd64-only). Commit on main with identity github@jedarden.com/jedarden, message like: ci: remove GitHub Actions (migrated to Argo Workflows sun-sim-build on iad-ci). Push.

Acceptance: .github/workflows/ absent on origin/main; no new GH Actions runs; Argo sensor is the only CI trigger.

title: Implement ADR-001: vendor Leaflet/SunCalc/Flatpickr into image, split cache-control headers
description: Implements the architecture decision recorded in docs/plan/plan.md ADR-001 (2026-07-20). Steps: 1) create vendor/ dir with leaflet@1.9.4, suncalc@1.9.0, and a pinned flatpickr version (JS+CSS for each); 2) update index.html to reference /vendor/... paths instead of the unpkg.com/cdn.jsdelivr.net URLs (currently around lines 9-14 and 477-481), dropping the now-unnecessary integrity=/crossorigin= attributes; 3) update Dockerfile to COPY vendor/ ./vendor/; 4) update serve.py's SunSimulatorHandler.end_headers to send 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' for paths under /vendor/ and keep the existing no-cache behavior for index.html and everything else; 5) verify locally with docker-compose up and confirm the map/date-picker/sun-calc still work with network devtools showing same-origin vendor requests, not CDN requests. Bump VERSION per repo convention (README '## Versioning' section) as part of the same commit.

title: Harden reverse-geocoding calls to Nominatim (throttle + usage-policy compliance)
description: index.html calls https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse directly from the client on pan/zoom (debounced, with an in-memory geocodeCache - see index.html ~lines 1074-1132). Nominatim's usage policy caps unauthenticated usage at 1 req/sec and requires a valid identifying User-Agent or Referer; heavy interactive panning by users sharing network egress could trip rate limiting and silently break the auto-city-name feature for everyone behind that egress point (e.g. this workspace's own Tailscale/Cloudflare egress if anyone here uses the tool). Concretely: 1) round lat/lon to fewer decimal places before cache-key/lookup to raise the cache-hit rate during continuous panning; 2) increase/verify the debounce interval is >=1s; 3) confirm the browser's default Referer header reaches Nominatim (it will, since this is a direct client-side fetch - document this in a comment so a future refactor to a server-side proxy doesn't drop it); 4) add a visible graceful fallback (e.g. just show coordinates) when the API 429s, instead of only console.warn (line ~1119).

title: Add URL query-param state for shareable/deep-linkable views (lat, lon, date, time)
description: index.html currently has zero use of URLSearchParams/location.hash/history — every session starts from the same default view and there is no way to share a specific location/date/time as a link. Add: on load, read ?lat=&lon=&date=&time= from the query string (falling back to current defaults if absent/invalid) and initialize the map/date-picker/timeline from them; on location/date/time change, update the URL via history.replaceState (no page reload, no new history entries per drag-frame — debounce it) so the current view is always a copy-pasteable link. High-value for a public interactive tool that gets shared (e.g. 'look at the sun angle here on this date'). File: index.html.

title: Pin flatpickr CDN version + add SRI hash to script/link tags
description: index.html loads flatpickr from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flatpickr with no version pin and no integrity= attribute (unlike the Leaflet tags, which have both). Pin it to an exact version (e.g. /npm/flatpickr@4.6.13/dist/flatpickr.min.js and matching .css) and add integrity= + crossorigin= attributes computed via 'openssl dgst -sha384 -binary file | openssl base64 -A'. Quick, low-risk interim fix independent of the larger vendoring decision in docs/plan/plan.md ADR-001 (do this regardless of whether/when ADR-001 is implemented). Files: index.html lines ~14, ~480-481.
